name: Dragontail Peak
blurb: The tallest wall in the Enchantments, climbed from turquoise Colchuck Lake by a glacier and a col.
permit: Overnight stays in the Enchantment Permit Area, including Colchuck Lake, need a permit from the yearly lottery. Day trips use a free self-issued permit at the trailhead. Northwest Forest Pass.

routes.name: Colchuck Glacier
routes.summary: The Colchuck Lake trail, boulders around the west shore, the Colchuck Glacier to Colchuck Col, then talus east to the summit. Many parties descend Aasgard Pass instead.
skills: Crampon and ice-axe use on 35° snow or ice
Off-trail travel on boulders and talus
A very long day if done car to car

line.source: Placed by hand on terrain data and published route descriptions; not surveyed

waypoints.name: Colchuck Lake
waypoints.note: Permit-only camps on the north shore.

sections.note: Stuart Lake trail, then the Colchuck Lake trail across Mountaineer Creek and up to the lake.
Around the west shore over boulders to the moraine.
Up the Colchuck Glacier to the col. No real crevasses, but it turns to hard ice late in the summer.
East from the col on talus and easy rock to the summit.

pois.name: Aasgard Pass
pois.note: The common descent: 2,200 ft of loose trail and boulders down to Colchuck Lake.
